summary.text: Tim Bosch is the Republican candidate for Missouri House of Representatives District 98 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Democratic incumbent Jaclyn Zimmermann.
He worked in telecommunications for more than 36 years, according to his Ballotpedia survey responses.

paragraphs.text: Tim Bosch graduated from Saint John Vianney High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Southeast Missouri State University in 1983.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he worked for SWBT/AT&T for more than 36 years, where he managed Business Services field operations for Missouri and Arkansas.
He said he has been married for 40 years, raised two daughters in Manchester, and coached his daughter's soccer and softball teams.
Bosch advanced from the Republican primary on August 4, 2026.
He listed cutting taxes, supporting law enforcement and first responders, and banning biological males from girls' sports as his key campaign messages, and said he supports funding for local schools.
